title: Automated runbook selection and evidence-bundle generation for Slack incident threads
creator: Ava Patel
description:
Problem: When high-severity incidents fire, on-call engineers must manually gather traces, errors, metric snapshots, and the most-relevant runbook(s) before deciding next steps. That slows TTR and causes inconsistent remediation actions.

Goal: Build a service that, upon Slack incident thread creation or PagerDuty acknowledgement, automatically selects 1–3 most relevant runbooks, compiles an evidence bundle (top spans, recent error logs, metric windows, latency histograms), attaches links to dashboards and recent PRs that touched the code paths, and posts a summarized message into the Slack incident thread with action buttons (Acknowledge, Run Quick-Rollback, Open Postmortem Draft).

Scope: MVP limited to HTTP/serving incidents routed by the tracing service + metrics ingestion (Prometheus) + logs (ELK). The MVP will support Slack automated posts and will create a pre-filled Postmortem draft in Confluence via API. PagerDuty integration: webhook trigger on acknowledge/escalate to start bundle collection.

Non-goals: Automated remediation beyond a single templated rollback shortcut (only for guarded services), full ML-based runbook ranking for all services (we’ll use a weighted heuristic at first).
acceptance_criteria: On PagerDuty acknowledge or new slack incident thread, a Slack message is posted within 20s with a 3-line summary and link to the evidence bundle
Evidence bundle contains: top 5 spans by error-rate impact, most recent 100 error logs (redacted), 15-minute CPU/GPU and request-latency histograms, and links to related dashboards
Automated selection returns a ranked list of 1–3 runbooks with justification strings (tags matched, recent-prs, error-signature similarity)
Slack message includes buttons: Acknowledge, Run Quick-Rollback (enabled only if service is in the rollback allowlist), Create Postmortem Draft
Confluence draft is created with pre-filled RCA sections and attached evidence links when 'Create Postmortem Draft' is clicked
End-to-end flow covered by integration tests and an ops tabletop exercise with SLO owners
tasks: Design runbook relevance heuristic (tags, trace span name match, error signature similarity, recent PR touch)
Build evidence-bundle assembler (trace sampler, log fetcher with redaction, metrics snapshotter, dashboard linker)
Implement Slack composer + interactive buttons + permission checks
PagerDuty webhook handler and rate-limiting for burst incidents
Confluence draft API integration and template mapping
Security review and data redaction policy sign-off
Tests: unit, integration (staging PD + staging Slack), and chaos tabletop run

2026-03-05 - Design review (Marta Ruiz): Proposed Slack message layout: summary, severity badge, runbook cards (compact), and an evidence link. Need to add explicit CTA for 'Escalate to on-call' and make the rollback button guarded behind an OAuth scope.

2026-03-06 - Liam Nguyen: Implemented backend for runbook ranking. Heuristic weights: tag match (40%), error-signature similarity (30%), recent activity (PRs in last 7 days) (20%), runbook adoption score (10%). Running ablation to validate weights against last 6 incidents.

2026-03-09 - Security (I. Gomez): Performed review of data flows. Confirmed redaction pipeline meets baseline. Requested that Confluence drafts are created in an ops-only space with restricted access. Marked security_review_required=true.
